map.百分比以什么为基数？: What is the base for the percentage?
map.中式烹饪多以主食材重（如面粉、肉）或总重为 100%，调料按其百分比计；统一基数: Chinese cooking usually takes the main ingredient weight (e.g. flour, meat) or total weight as 100%, with seasonings as a percentage; a unified base is needed to compare different recipes horizontally.
map.出成率 = 净料重 ÷ 毛料重 × 100%；如土豆去皮后 800g / 毛重: Yield rate = net material weight / gross material weight x 100%; e.g. potato after peeling 800g / gross 1000g = 80%, for cost and usage estimation.
map.腌肉加盐 2% 是通用值吗？: Is 2% salt for cured meat a universal value?
map.家常腌肉约 1–2% 盐（占肉重），酱肉、腊肉更高；具体按口味与保存需求调整，本: Home-cured meat about 1-2% salt (of meat weight), sauce-cured and bacon higher; adjust by taste and preservation need; this tool only does percentage conversion.
